_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_attack_despite_defender.py. t_add_felothar is Felothar's defender line alone; t_add_sentinels is Weathered Sentinels' per-player waiver on a 2/4 defender; t_add_formation is Assault Formation's targeted line on a {T} cost; t_add_gargoyle is Wakestone Gargoyle's group line on a {T} cost. The wall they free is the pool's t_wall.
